findings.ac: `nw worker info --json` prints the documented keys
findings.title: Plain (non-JSON) `nw worker info` output is untested
findings.detail: Only `info --json` is tested. The plain `key: value` path in cli_worker.worker_info is never run. It is cosmetic and outside the AC.

findings.ac: `nw worker ssh-command` execs the four allowed subcommands and refuses everything else
findings.title: ssh-command is only tested in-process, never through the click command
findings.detail: test_worker_ssh_command.py calls W.ssh_command(environ) directly. No test runs `nw worker ssh-command` as a subprocess with SSH_ORIGINAL_COMMAND set to a refused command to check exit 2 at the CLI layer, so the `raise SystemExit(...)` wiring is unverified. The risk is low.

findings.ac: Two concurrent gate-jobs for the same repo_key with different base.sha
findings.title: The concurrent-jobs gate busy-polls with `sleep 0.1` in shell
findings.detail: The rendezvous loop in test_concurrent_jobs_see_their_own_base polls the sync dir with `sleep 0.1`. It is bounded by the gate's 60 s timeout and the test pins slots: 2, but it still relies on a wall-clock wait under load. Accepted flakiness risk.

coverage_assessment.ac: Piping a valid header and bundle runs the gates and emits accepted, started, a gate frame per gate (with .log, .json, .r<n>) and done
git merge-base $NW_BASE HEAD on the worker prints the coordinator's sha
An env key outside the allowlist gives an error frame with stage validate and nothing runs; a reused job_id gives stage claim
Two concurrent jobs with different base.sha for the same base.name each see their own base
EOF mid-gate kills the gate and sends done interrupted; EOF during the slot wait sends done interrupted with no started
With the slot held, slot_wait comes first and started only once the slot frees
Exit 0 after done (pass, fail or interrupted), 3 after error
A log over 16 MiB arrives cut to 16 MiB with truncated_bytes in its sidecar
have reports the commit and base after the job; gc --keep-days 0 removes refs, objects and job dirs, but a live job's dir survives
ssh-command execs the four allowed subcommands and refuses everything else with exit 2, running nothing
docs/WORKFLOW.md documents the mandatory dedicated user and the absolute-path key line
tests: manual (per test plan); the diff adds the 'Remote gate worker' section with the mandatory user and the command="/home/user/.local/bin/nw worker ssh-command",restrict line
